"''Cold. But quiet.|Howzer and Samson on comms|}} '''Samson''' was a [[clone trooper]] who eventually joined the [[Clone Underground|clone resistance network]] that was created by [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]] early in the [[Imperial Era]]. Samson traveled to [[Pantora]] with [[Greer]], [[Howzer]], [[Nemec]], and [[Rex]] to help protect [[Senator]] [[Avi Singh]] during his meeting with Senator [[Riyo Chuchi]] on [[Pantora]]. Following the mission, they returned to their base at the [[Teth]] [[B'omarr Order Monastery]], where he was patrolling the base. They were killed by [[CX-2]], a [[Clone X trooper]] working for [[Doctor]] [[Royce Hemlock]]. ==Biography== ===Early life=== Samson was created on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] as a [[Cloning|clone]] of the [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] to serve in the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Grand Army of the Republic|clone army]] during the [[Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]]. ===Part of the Underground=== At some point, Samson joined the [[Clone Underground]] resistance network. During or after [[18 BBY]], Samson and fellow [[clone trooper]]s [[Greer]], [[Howzer]], [[Nemec]] and [[Rex]] were deployed on a mission to protect [[Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi]] and Senator [[Avi Singh]] while they held a clandestine [[Riyo Chuchi and Avi Singh's secret meeting|meeting]] on the [[planet]] [[Pantora]]. Although Senators Singh and Chuchi had been on opposite sides during the war, both former Republic and Separatist worlds had a growing discontent with [[Darth Sidious|Emperor Palpatine]] and the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]]. While the meeting was in session, Imperial [[Clone X trooper]] [[CX-1]] had infiltrated [[Pantora tea parlor|tea parlor]] where the meeting was taking place, attempting to kill the senators. [[Captain]] Rex foiled the attempt however, and alongside Nemec, helped Howzer incapacitate and capture the assassin. Following the assassin's capture, Samson accompanied the rest of their squad back to their headquarters at the [[B'omarr Order Monastery]] on the planet [[Teth]]. Samson assumed guard duty along the monastery's perimeter. Later, when Rex contacted [[Clone Force 99|the Bad Batch]] to meet with him at his base, Samson accompanied Rex and Howzer when they came to greet the defective clones. After a brief conversation between the two groups, they entered the monastery and Samson returned to his regular duties. However, another clone assassin, [[CX-2]] had landed on the planet and made his way up to the monastery. Upon reaching the courtyard, CX-2 managed to evade Samson's detection and place [[thermal detonator]]s on both [[Rho-class transport shuttle|''Rho''-class transport shuttles]] the resistance network were in possession of. After briefly entering the monastery and confirming the two targets on his register, CX-2 returned outside and remotely activated one of the detonators, destroying a shuttle in the process. Witnessing the transport shuttle explode, Samson and another clone trooper ran toward the explosion, drawing their weapons and assuming a defensive stance. CX-2 then activated the other explosive, which caught Samson and his companion in the blast radius, [[Death|killing]] them. ===Legacy=== Moments after his death, the [[Recovery Strike Team]], led by [[Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe]] and [[clone commando]] [[Clone Lieutenant|Lieutenant]] [[Hilo]], entered the monastery grounds. While his squad secured the perimeter, Wolffe noticed Samson's body and expressed shock that the supposed insurgents they had been alerted of were clone troopers. Later, after the remaining members of the Clone Underground escaped Teth alongside the Bad Batch, Wolffe ordered his men to recover the bodies of Rex's deceased clones, including Samson's.{{TBB|Extraction}} ==Personality and traits== As a genetic clone of [[Jango Fett]], Samson was a human male with black hair, brown eyes, and tan skin. Samson stood at a height of 1.83 meters tall. ==Equipment== Samson wore standard [[Phase II clone trooper armor]] with customized [[Color|indigo]] markings. Additionally, they adorned a [[blaster]] holster on their left leg, a sheath on his left wrist, small pouches on both of his arms and ankles, a medium pouch on their right leg, a large pouch satchel slung over his chest, and a blaster holder on their back. Samson wielded a [[Vibroknife|vibro-knife]], a [[DC-17 repeater hand blaster|DC-17 hand blaster]], and a [[DC-15A blaster rifle]]. ==Behind the scenes== Samson appeared in "[[Infiltration (episode)|Infiltration]]," the sixth episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'''s [[The Bad Batch Season 3|third season]], which premiered on [[March 13]], [[2024]] on [[Disney+]].{{SW|text=Watch the ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 3 Trailer|url=news/the-bad-batch-season-3-trailer}} Samson was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], the voice actor for every clone trooper in ''The Bad Batch'' and other animated star wars media including ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (television series)|Tales of the Jedi]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]].''{{OfficialYouTube|channel=@EntertainmentTonight|name=Entertainment Tonight|link=Wikipedia:Entertainment Tonight|video=1UxfT-LUFUE|text=Star Wars: The Bad Batch: Dee Bradley Baker Breaks Down Each Clone's Voice|quote=ET's Ash Crossan spoke with voice actor Dee Bradley Baker, who demonstrates the character voices in the all-new 'Star Wars' animated series, 'The Bad Batch,' now streaming on Disney+.}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Samson}} *{{TBB|Infiltration (episode)}} {{1st}} *{{TBB|Extraction}} {{Corpse}} *{{Rebels|The Lost Commanders}} {{1stm}} {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Samson |fr=Samson |ka=სემსონი }} [[Category:Clone troopers]] [[Category:Clone Underground members]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
